text:
Leena Patel: Kicking off the Teryx alpha compatibility pilot — quick sync. Need NDA status, one lab slot, a short benchmark plan, and SI contact. @Omar any infra lead at Teryx we should loop in? Link to onboarding doc: https://rwd-internal/docs/partnerships/teryx-onboard (draft).
Omar Ruiz: Talia Moreno is our infra contact at Teryx, cc'd via email earlier. Legal confirmed Teryx signed our NDA yesterday — I uploaded the signed PDF to Drive: https://drive.redwood/teryx/nda_signed.pdf
Marta Voss: Scope question — which models + workloads for alpha? My proposal: 1) small chat (seq 512) 2) assistant long-context (seq 8k) 3) embeddings microbench. Also want a smoke compatibility test for quantized variants.
Samir Chen: Metric list suggestion: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, sustained throughput at target batch sizes, GPU memory high-water, power draw sample, and failure-rate over 4-hr soak. Also add a deterministic request set for quality checks.
Leena Patel: Agree with Marta + Samir. For the alpha run let's keep it tight: 3 workloads, ~30min each, then a 4-hr soak on the most common config. Who can own the microbenchmark script?
Marta Voss: I can own the script. Will push a minimal runner today. Example run command (will live in the repo):
```
./microbench --model redwood-q8 --seq 512 --batch 8 --duration 1800 --report out.json
```
Jonah Kline: Quick note on comms: partner asked about embargo window for any joint blog/bench release — propose 30 days after alpha signoff for internal review, 45 days for public. Marketing lead: @Leena please confirm.
Omar Ruiz: Talia asked for our logging/telemetry contract — we should send a one-page summary. I'll draft and post to the thread. Also, Teryx ops prefers we use their lab runner (SSH key provided) vs our ephemeral runners.
PartnerBot: Lab booking confirmed — Teryx Alpha Lab slot: 2024-12-05 08:00-12:00 PT. Reservation ID: LAB-7721.
Leena Patel: Action items: Omar — post telemetry one-pager + infra contact details by EOD. Marta — PR for microbench runner and sample input set by EOD. Samir — finalize metric dashboard (Grafana panel ids) and the 4-hr soak check list by tomorrow noon. Jonah — coordinate embargo timeline with marketing and partner comms. I'll follow up with Talia for final handoff. :thumbsup:
Samir Chen: One more thing — can we capture power telemetry? Teryx said they'll provide PDUs, but need our script to poll. I'll add PDU read steps to the runner.
Marta Voss: noted — will add a pdu_poll flag to the script.
Leena Patel: Great. If no blockers, I'll send a kickoff email to Talia and their engineering manager with the plan and the Drive links. :eyes:
Omar Ruiz: No blockers from infra side. Go ahead.
Leena Patel: Sending kickoff now.
Leena Patel: (sent) Email thread created with Talia, all action items in the doc. Will update here with any replies.
Jonah Kline: Thanks everyone — keeping this lean so we can get meaningful results quickly. :rocket:
